title: Anomaly sentinel (AI incident investigator)
tagline: A statistical detector spots anomalies in microservice metrics in about 30 s, and a Claude Opus 5.5 agent explains the root cause with evidence.
problem: When production breaks, the alert names a symptom, not a cause, and the on-call engineer spends the first 20 minutes opening dashboards, reading logs and checking deploys by hand.
built: Four FastAPI microservices emit Prometheus metrics and logs. A robust z-score on a seasonal median baseline plus an Isolation Forest flag anomalies and group them into incidents. A Claude Opus 5.5 agent then investigates with six read-only tools and streams a structured root-cause report, with cost, to a React dashboard. Statistics decide when something is wrong; the model only explains why.
highlights: Eight-scenario eval: 8/8 incidents detected, 29 s mean latency, 0 false incidents
Six capped tools instead of a data dump; prompt caching with cached tokens shown beside the cost
Typed reports through a pydantic schema; a refusal marks the incident incomplete
A mock provider runs the real path, so CI needs no API key
testing: 34 automated tests across the detector, agent, API and dashboard, plus a Playwright smoke test on the full Docker stack, all green in CI; an eight-scenario eval harness writes its results into the README.
